global: This shoyu ramen features a clear, amber broth with tender chashu pork and a halved soft-boiled egg. Bean sprouts and green onions crown the noodles in a white bowl with red trim, set against a warm, softly lit background.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and slight sheen under ambient lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red concentric rings, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-brown, clear, and glossy, with visible noodles and bean sprouts floating on its surface.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows creamy white albumen and a firm, orange-yellow yolk with a slightly textured surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: browned, tender-looking meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven, textured surface.
